semiconductor_relevance: High — Focussia provides automation and connectivity solutions specifically designed for semiconductor fabs and OEMs.
summary: Focussia specializes in automation and connectivity solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on enhancing the integration of Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) and ensuring compliance with SEMI E84 protocols. Their products, such as SmartboxE84 and SmartGem, facilitate seamless connectivity and data collection, thereby reducing engineering efforts and integration risks.
capabilities: SmartboxE84 for SEMI E84 protocol integration
SmartPassThrough for data collection and equipment upgrades
